purpose: API/source catalogue for island for-sale listings feature

sources.name: Rightmove
sources.apiNotes: Real Time Data Feed (ADF) is for estate agents to publish stock, not a consumer search API.
sources.decisionReason: No searchable public API; scraping blocked by ETHICS.md.

sources.name: Zoopla (ZPG)
sources.apiNotes: Public listings API discontinued; agent leads/performance APIs remain.
sources.decisionReason: No public listings API without ZPG commercial agreement.

sources.name: OnTheMarket / PrimeLocation
sources.decisionReason: No open aggregate feed for third-party atlas use.

sources.name: Homedata UK
sources.apiNotes: REST API includes live-listings and bulk export; cites OGL underlying sources. Must confirm Terms allow static redistribution in islands.json.
sources.decisionReason: First aggregate API candidate; implement behind HOMEDATA_API_KEY.

sources.name: PropertyData
sources.decisionReason: Paid; redistribution terms unlikely to suit static JSON ship.

sources.name: HM Land Registry Price Paid
sources.apiNotes: Completed sales only — not current for-sale listings.
sources.decisionReason: Wrong signal for 'for sale now'; useful for history only.

sources.name: Curated specialist brokers
sources.apiNotes: Maintainer-edited data/curated_property_listings.json with outbound URLs to private-island brokers and regional agents.
sources.decisionReason: MVP path; ethics-safe; ships with ingest_property_listings.py.
